turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Quick one, I'm standing at the avocados. How do I know which ones are ready?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Give one a gentle squeeze in your palm, not with your fingertips. Ripe ones give a little, like a firm peach.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then buy them anyway if you need them in a few days. Leave them on the counter and they'll soften.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I need one for tonight though.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh wait, there's a bag of softer ones on the bottom shelf.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Those are often the ripe ones they've marked down. Check under the little stem cap, green underneath is good, brown means it's gone too far.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Green. Perfect. And if I only use half?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Keep the stone in the other half, cover the cut side tightly and put it in the fridge. It'll be fine until tomorrow.
